{{Top|leg}}
'''Zolall venom''' was produced by the [[zolall]], an animal native to to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]]. The venom was used as a [[Poison/Legends|poison]] by the sect of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] known as the [[Loag]]. In a modified form, it could also be used as an [[Anesthetic gas|anesthetic]].
